title: 7. Tenure and Qualifications of Council Members

blocks.content:
Tenure:
• Term – 6 years
• One-third members retire every two years

Qualifications:
• Citizen of India
• Minimum age – 30 years
One-third members retire every two years

items: Exam questions frequently test the minimum age for Council membership (30 years) versus Assembly membership (25 years).
Remember that 1/3rd of members retire every 2 years, which is a key structural feature tested in Indian Polity exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The total tenure of a Council member is fixed at 6 years.
One-third of the total members retire every two years, ensuring the Council remains a continuous body.
Indian citizenship is a mandatory qualification for membership.
Candidates must be at least 30 years old to be eligible for membership.
